rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for getting something back or retrieving it.

example.english: I’m going back to the old house to retrieve my book.

rows.note: Use this when fetching a physical thing and bringing it back here, with the return direction made explicit.

example.english: Remember to retrieve the umbrella from the car and bring it back here.

rows.note: Use this mainly for retrieving or reading a file, record, or other data in a computing context.

example.english: The system is still trying to retrieve the data from your Octopus card.
